map_wrong: Hmm… I don't think it's here.

prologue.text: This is Puppy Land, a country on the sea.
Puppy Land has many islands. One of them is our Newton Island.
Every night the guiding star lights up the sea. So the boats never get lost!
Without starlight, you can't see a thing on the dark sea. The boats can't find their way.
I saw the pieces fall. The meadow, the hill, the playground, the pond… all over the island!
Each piece is hidden in a different place. You have to throw a ball, push a box or float a barrel to get it.

finale.text: We did it! We found all the pieces!
Put the pieces back together and the star can shine again. Let's send it back to the sky.
Pull the star down like a slingshot and let go! The harder you pull, the faster and higher it flies.

finale_after.text: The star is shining again! The sea is bright!
Wow… it's warmer than a bread oven.
Now the boats can find their way at night.

finale_next: A new island opened across the sea! Tap Back and let's go!
finale_retry: Gravity pulled the star back down. Pull harder!
